# Rashid Iqbal - Freelance Web Developer & Designer

> Professional web developer specializing in high-converting landing pages, web applications, and mobile apps.

## About

Rashid Iqbal is a freelance web developer and designer based in Pakistan. He specializes in building modern, performant websites using Next.js, Framer, Figma, Expo, and Flutter.

## Services

- **Landing Pages**: High-converting, beautifully designed landing pages
- **Web Applications**: Full-stack web applications with modern tech stacks
- **Mobile Apps**: Cross-platform mobile applications using Expo and Flutter
- **UI/UX Design**: User interface and experience design with Figma
- **Framer Development**: Interactive prototypes and production websites

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile: Expo, React Native, Flutter
- Design: Figma, Framer
- Backend: Node.js, Supabase, Firebase
